product: Use cleaned AI answers in Lakeflow Designer (Public Preview)
tagline: Clean supported AI Function outputs in Lakeflow Designer for downstream transformations.
what_it_does: Clean supported AI Function outputs in Lakeflow Designer for downstream transformations. Cleaned results include answer values, error messages, and raw responses in separate columns. Lakeflow Designer includes built in operators for common data preparation and transformation tasks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: Clean supported AI Function outputs in Lakeflow Designer for downstream transformations. Cleaned results include answer values, error messages, and raw responses in separate columns.
